cloud_model_name.description: Gemini model that Firebase AI Logic calls for cloud parsing.

route_max_device_chars.description: Longest note (chars) that the on-device model may parse.

route_language_threshold.description: Pidgin/Yoruba score (0..1) above which a note is sent to the cloud model.

route_min_battery.description: Battery level (0..1) below which an unplugged device sends work to the cloud.

prompt_version_parse.description: Version of the parse prompt that both apps assemble.

cloud_enabled.description: Kill switch for all cloud AI calls. False keeps AI on device or queued.

cloud_rate_limit_per_minute.description: Most cloud AI calls one device may make per minute.
